prompt:
Support ticket: "My project cover came back as failed, and 15 credits were gone anyway. Same thing happened earlier with a character sheet."
Users must not pay for AI work that failed. Fix it everywhere credits are charged, not only for covers. Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Users want to see where their credits went. Add `GET /api/v1/workspaces/{id}/credits/history`: the workspace's credit changes, newest first, with every charge, refund and daily refill. Each item has `amount` (negative for a charge), `action` and `created_at`. A refunded charge and its refund both appear.
Only members of the workspace may read it; to anyone else the workspace does not exist (404). Add tests.
On the Settings page, under the credit balance, show this history: when, what it was for, and the amount, with refunds marked as refunds. Both languages.

report.answer: Settings now shows credit history beneath the workspace balance in English and Korean, with localized dates, activity descriptions, signed amounts, and explicit refund labels. Type-checking and lint passed.

+from uuid import UUID
+
+import pytest
+from sqlmodel import Session, select
+
+from app.db.engine import engine
+from app.models.models import CreditTransaction, Workspace
+from app.services.ai import ai_service
+from tests.conftest import signup
+
+
+def assert_billing(workspace_id, costs):
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        assert session.get(Workspace, workspace_id).credits == 500 - sum(costs)
+        debits = session.exec(select(CreditTransaction).where(CreditTransaction.workspace_id == workspace_id, CreditTransaction.amount < 0)).all()
+        assert sorted(-entry.amount for entry in debits) == sorted(costs)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind,cost", [("cover", 15), ("character", 20)])
+def test_failed_background_generation_then_success(client, monkeypatch, kind, cost):
+    headers = signup(client)
+    workspace_id = UUID(client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=headers).json()[0]["id"])
+    projects = "/api/v1/projects"
+    project = client.post(projects, headers=headers, json={"title": "Night Bus", "genres": []}).json()
+    if kind == "cover":
+        resource = f"{projects}/{project['id']}"
+        url = f"{resource}/cover"
+        method, field = "generate_project_cover_image", "cover_image_status"
+    else:
+        characters = "/api/v1/characters"
+        character = client.post(characters, headers=headers, json={
+            "project_id": project["id"], "name": "Jin"
+        }).json()
+        resource = f"{characters}/{character['id']}"
+        url = f"{resource}/generate"
+        method, field = "generate_character_sheet", "sheet_status"
+
+    for image, status, costs in [(b"", "failed", []), (b"image", "completed", [cost])]:
+        monkeypatch.setattr(ai_service, method, lambda *args, **kwargs: image)
+        response = client.post(url, headers=headers)
+        assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
+        assert client.get(resource, headers=headers).json()[field] == status
+        assert_billing(workspace_id, costs)
+
+
+def test_synchronous_render_charges_only_on_success(client, monkeypatch):
+    headers = signup(client)
+    workspace_id = UUID(client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=headers).json()[0]["id"])
+
+    def fail(*args, **kwargs):
+        raise RuntimeError("provider unavailable")
+
+    url = "/api/v1/scenes/render"
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ai_service, "generate_image", fail)
+    assert client.post(url, headers=headers, json={"prompt": "night"}).status_code == 500
+    assert_billing(workspace_id, [])
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ai_service, "generate_image", lambda *args, **kwargs: b"image")
+    assert client.post(url, headers=headers, json={"prompt": "night"}).status_code == 200
+    assert_billing(workspace_id, [12])
+
+
+def test_insufficient_credits_prevent_generation(client, monkeypatch):
+    headers = signup(client)
+    workspace_id = UUID(client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=headers).json()[0]["id"])
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        workspace = session.get(Workspace, workspace_id)
+        workspace.credits = 11
+        session.commit()
+
+    def unexpected_generation(*args, **kwargs):
+        pytest.fail("Generation started with insufficient credits")
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ai_service, "generate_image", unexpected_generation)
+    response = client.post("/api/v1/scenes/render", headers=headers, json={"prompt": "night"})
+    assert response.status_code == 402
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        assert session.get(Workspace, workspace_id).credits == 11

@@ -0,0 +1,56 @@
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta
+from uuid import UUID, uuid4
+
+from sqlmodel import Session
+
+from app.db.engine import engine
+from app.models.models import CreditTransaction, WorkspaceMember
+from tests.conftest import signup
+
+
+def workspace(client, headers):
+    return client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=headers).json()[0]
+
+
+def test_member_sees_all_workspace_transactions_newest_first(client):
+    owner = signup(client)
+    reader = signup(client, "reader@example.com")
+    target = workspace(client, owner)
+    other = workspace(client, reader)
+    url = f"/api/v1/workspaces/{target['id']}/credits/history"
+    assert client.get(url, headers=owner).json() == []
+
+    start = datetime(2026, 1, 1)
+    action = "generate_project_cover_image"
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        session.add(WorkspaceMember(workspace_id=UUID(target["id"]), user_id=UUID(other["owner_id"]), role="member"))
+        for ws, amount, label, day in [
+            (target, 15, "refund", 1),
+            (other, -20, "generate_character_sheet", 3),
+            (target, -15, action, 0),
+            (target, 50, "daily_refill", 2),
+        ]:
+            session.add(CreditTransaction(
+                workspace_id=UUID(ws["id"]), user_id=UUID(ws["owner_id"]),
+                amount=amount, action_type=label, timestamp=start + timedelta(days=day),
+            ))
+        session.commit()
+
+    response = client.get(url, headers=reader)
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert response.json() == [
+        {"amount": 50, "action": "daily_refill", "created_at": "2026-01-03T00:00:00"},
+        {"amount": 15, "action": "refund", "created_at": "2026-01-02T00:00:00"},
+        {"amount": -15, "action": action, "created_at": "2026-01-01T00:00:00"},
+    ]
+
+
+def test_nonmember_and_missing_workspace_receive_same_404(client):
+    target = workspace(client, signup(client))
+    outsider = signup(client, "outsider@example.com")
+    responses = [
+        client.get(f"/api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/credits/history", headers=outsider)
+        for workspace_id in (target["id"], uuid4())
+    ]
+    assert [r.status_code for r in responses] == [404, 404]
+    assert responses[0].json() == responses[1].json()
